about: Files moved here byte for byte from the engine (trillion-rust src/account_rights), where the sharing grants lived until lane engine-leftovers-out removed them (the owner, Nov 15 2026: anything that is not one of the five core jobs is a tool and leaves the engine; account_rights keeps run_capability, resource_authority and auth_pass). Each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Nothing was changed but one made-up address in a test (calls). Not wired: this tool writes the sharing record the engine read; adapting a file is a later commit that names this receipt.

calls.means: one test input with a user part before the host: the host name after it (the test's made-up sharer host, with its ending) is written example.com, because the address shape rules refuse a made-up host written as an email; the find names the place, the ending also changes

files.returned: door_grant.act returned to trillion-rust src/account_rights/share-grant.json (lane run-grant-at-the-owners-door), with the keep, list and run operations the engine reads there.

The run grant (Act, Identity, Reach, ActData, ActIssuer, principal_fits, principal, keeps, keep_asked, acting, tool_input, vault_name, keep, withdraw, still_kept, kept_party, Authenticator and their tests) returned to trillion-rust src/account_rights/share_grant.rs (lane run-grant-at-the-owners-door), read from the sharer's vault alone; rights_for and its two tests left with them and are in trillion-workshop d6df86771, since the engine answers no records operation. The read shares, reach shares and public links stay here.
